title: ServiceDescription
description: A build-time scaffold inventory, not a live server health response.

async_runtime.description: Selected async runtime, or null while undecided.

components.description: Modules included in this build-time inventory.

http_listening.description: Whether this process starts an HTTP listener; currently always false.

server_framework.description: Selected HTTP framework, or null while undecided.

version.description: Version of the compiled descriptor binary.

Component.description: A repository component and an honest description of its implementation stage.

id.description: Stable inventory key, unique within the descriptor.

language.description: Implemented language or an explicitly open integration choice.

layer.description: Layer that owns the module's responsibility.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the source or module boundary.

status.description: Implementation stage; this is not runtime health.

summary.description: Actual scaffold behavior or the proposed responsibility.

ComponentStatus.description: Whether a module has scaffolding or only a proposed responsibility.

oneOf.description: Source scaffolding exists; the summary states its actual behavior.
The module has no implemented product behavior.

Layer.description: Architectural ownership of a component, not its deployment location.
